string-array.name: about_contrib_rillwyn
string-array.item: v0.2.0 — Core rewrite: migrated the module to the libxposed Modern Xposed API (101) and rebuilt the UI (Material 3 status diagnostics, MAC editor, three-page navigation).
v0.2.1 — Maintainer: integrated community PR #1 (multi-vendor support, zero-click apply, Arabic & RTL), set up CI auto-build/release and documentation.
v0.2.5 — Repository maintainer: updated to libxposed API 102, UI polish (Material 3 language dropdown & About page scrolling), and release coordination.

string-array.name: about_contrib_amr
string-array.item: v0.2.1 — PR #1: multi-vendor Wi-Fi stack compatibility, zero-click instant apply, Arabic localization & RTL layouts, and documentation/KDoc.
v0.2.5 — Dynamic RTL/LTR seamless switching without app restart, About page scroll and overflow fix with expansion auto-scroll, and modern API 102 integration.
